announcements.headline: Subsea 7 - awarded contract offshore US
announcements.insight: This contract award reinforces Subsea 7's position in the US offshore wind supply chain, a high-growth segment offsetting volatility in traditional oil & gas services, though it represents routine order book replenishment rather than a strategic inflection point.

announcements.headline: Subsea7 - Sale of heavy transportation business
announcements.insight: This divestment aligns with Subsea7's strategic pivot to reduce capital intensity and improve free cash flow generation by shedding heavy lift assets, a move consistent with broader industry trends towards asset-light models in the offshore energy sector.

announcements.headline: Subsea 7 - CADE Approves the Combination of Subsea7 and Saipem
announcements.insight: This regulatory approval finalizes the transformative merger between Subsea7 and Saipem's offshore activities, creating a dominant global player in the subsea sector with enhanced scale to compete against incumbents like TechnipFMC and McDermott amid rising offshore wind demand.
